home.faqFreeA: Yes! All games are completely free to play online — no sign-up, no subscription, no hidden fees.
home.faqAccount: Do I need to create an account?
home.faqAccountA: Not at all. You can start playing immediately. Your game history and queue are saved automatically in your browser.
home.faqMobile: Can I play on my phone or tablet?
home.faqMobileA: Absolutely. RetroVault is mobile-first and works on any device with a modern browser. Touch controls are built in.
home.faqSave: How do I save my progress?
home.faqSaveA: Progress is saved automatically when you switch games or close the emulator. Your saves stay in your browser for next time.
home.faqPlatformsA: We have 23 platforms including NES, SNES, Game Boy Advance, Arcade, Nintendo 64, PlayStation, Sega Genesis, and more.
home.faqStuck: A game isn't loading / the emulator is stuck
home.faqStuckA: Try refreshing the page. If the issue persists, the ROM may be temporarily unavailable — try another game and check back later.

about.subtitle: Pixel Heart
about.para1: 🎮 RETRO VAULT is a retro gaming site built by enthusiasts. We collect, curate, and share the purest pixel gaming experiences — playable right in your browser.
about.para2: 📅 Founded in 2026. Our mission: a pixel utopia combining game library, community, and retro culture. Every game is hand-picked and preserved for future generations of pixel lovers.
